This is sampled finite-short-trajectory evidence only, not a continuous-time supremum or long-time stability theorem.
next_if_pass: Freeze a separate moderate-k time-widening gate using the already-established low-k s3c/s3d methodology before widening the k-domain to 0.01 or 0.03 Mpc^-1.
non_claims: not a continuous-time supremum theorem between sampled endpoints
not long-time or cosmological-time moderate-k stability
